title_zh: 中国青铜时代（中原总览）

names.zh: 中国青铜时代（中原总览）

civilization.region: East Asia / China — Central Plains (Yellow River middle–lower reaches) focus
civilization.time_span: Erlitou–Erligang early-state window ~1900/1800–1250 BCE; Late Shang ~1250–1046 BCE (Liu & Chen 2012); XSZCP bands contested

summary.zh: 中原学术常规框架下的中国青铜时代：二里头、二里岗、殷墟安阳与商–周青铜礼器传统；夏史实性不写成定论；与三星堆分条。
summary.en: Central Plains scholarly conventional frame for China’s Bronze Age (Erlitou / Erligang / Anyang–Yinxu and Shang–Zhou ritual bronzes); Xia historicity not asserted as settled fact; Sanxingdui kept separate.

sites.kind_note: Central Plains Early Bronze Age typesite

summary.zh: 中原早期青铜时代关键类型遗址；Thorp 1991 最小考古定义不预设夏史实。
summary.en: Key Early Bronze Age typesite; Thorp 1991 minimal definition does not assume Xia historicity.

names.zh: 郑州商城及相关二里岗中心

sites.kind_note: Early metropolitan horizon under Erligang frame

summary.zh: Campbell 二里岗期与 Liu & Chen 早期国家框架下的早期都会/中心；不编造城墙长度或宫殿清单。
summary.en: Early metropolitan horizons under Campbell’s Erligang chapter and Liu & Chen’s early-state frame; no invented wall lengths or palace inventories.

summary.zh: Campbell 专章所标二里岗—安阳过渡期重要地点。
summary.en: Transitional locales in Campbell’s dedicated chapter between Erligang and Anyang.

sites.kind_note: Late Shang capital zone; oracle bones, royal cemeteries, workshops

summary.zh: 晚商都城考古区；甲骨文、王陵与铸铜手工业核心出土地。
summary.en: Late Shang capital zone; core for oracle bones, royal cemeteries, and bronze workshops.

time.label: within early-state window ~1900/1800–1250 BC (front segment)
time.scheme_note: Liu & Chen 2012; Thorp 1991 minimal definition — not equated with Xia dynasty

summary.zh: 考古文化标签；≠已证夏朝。
summary.en: Archaeological culture label; not equated with proven Xia dynasty.

time.label: later segment of ~1900/1800–1250 BC early-state window

summary.zh: 早期国家窗后段；Campbell 独立二里岗期章。
summary.en: Later early-state window; Campbell’s dedicated Erligang chapter.

summary.zh: 二里岗与安阳之间的过渡视界。
summary.en: Transitional horizon between Erligang and Anyang.

time.label: ~1250–1046 BC
time.scheme_note: Liu & Chen 2012 Late Shang chapter; Keightley Wu Ding–Di Xin oracle-bone era

summary.zh: 晚商及其邻境；甲骨文王室占卜时代。
summary.en: Late Shang and neighbors; oracle-bone royal divination era.

names.zh: Liu & Chen 资源获取研究窗

summary.zh: 金属与盐等外部资源获取动力学讨论窗。
summary.en: Window for metal and salt external resource procurement dynamics.

summary.zh: 鼎、簋等容器与兵器、乐器；Bagley 1987 Sackler 专书为英语标准入口。
summary.en: Vessels (ding, gui, etc.), weapons, and bells; Bagley 1987 Sackler volume is the standard English entry.

summary.zh: 武丁至帝辛约八九位商王时期；约十万片卜骨/卜甲残片；可系统释读的早期中国书写传统。
summary.en: Roughly eight or nine kings Wu Ding to Di Xin; ~100,000 scapula/plastron fragments; systematically readable early Chinese writing.

names.zh: 二里头声望玉器与礼器（组合级）
names.en: Erlitou prestige jades and ritual objects (assemblage-level)

summary.zh: 二里头墓葬/礼仪语境中的玉礼器与声望物品；最小考古定义。
summary.en: Prestige jades and ritual objects in Erlitou burial/ritual contexts under minimal archaeological definition.

statement.zh: 本条以二里头考古文化、二里岗、殷墟安阳与商–周青铜礼器传统为中原学术常规框架中心。
statement.en: This entry centers Erlitou archaeological culture, Erligang, Anyang/Yinxu Late Shang, and Shang–Zhou ritual bronze traditions as a Central Plains scholarly conventional frame.

statement.zh: 晚商安阳甲骨文是可系统释读的早期中国书写传统，记录王室占卜及相关礼仪/行政议题。
statement.en: Late Shang Anyang oracle-bone script is among the earliest systematically readable Chinese writing traditions, recording royal divination and related ritual/administrative concerns.

statement.zh: Liu & Chen 2003 强调约公元前 1800–1400 年早期国家形成与金属、盐等关键外部资源获取相关。
statement.en: Liu & Chen 2003 emphasize early-state dynamics ~1800–1400 BCE linked to procurement of key external resources, especially metal and salt.

statement.zh: Liu & Chen 2012 与 Flad & Chen 2013 强调社会政治演化多中心性；青铜时代中国不止中原一条线。
statement.en: Liu & Chen 2012 and Flad & Chen 2013 stress multicentric sociopolitical evolution; Bronze Age China is not only a Central Plains story.

statement.zh: 夏王朝历史真实性不写成定论；Thorp 1991 对二里头材料采「最小」考古定义，不预设夏史实。
statement.en: Xia dynasty historicity is not asserted as settled fact; Thorp 1991 proposes a minimal archaeological definition of Erlitou that does not assume Xia historicity.

claims.disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

statement.zh: 夏商周断代工程简本绝对年方案（如夏始约 2070、商始约 1600、西周始 1046 BCE）属有争议的项目方案，不作唯一年表。
statement.en: XSZCP brief absolute bands (e.g. Xia ~2070, Shang ~1600, Western Zhou 1046 BCE) are a contested national project scheme, not treated as unique dogma.

claims.disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
